subject: Custom SLA appendix & technical profile for pilot (OrthoSight)
messages:
From: Maya R. Singh <m.singh@orthosight.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orthosight.com
Date: 2026-04-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot SLA ask - uptime & P95 latency guarantees

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the model behavior looked promising. Procurement wants to capture a short appendix to the MSA/SOW that specifies availability and latency commitments for our initial pilot. High level items we need called out:

- Availability target: 99.99% (monthly), with defined measurement method and credits
- P95 inference latency for /v1/generate < 150ms (regional)
- Regional failover expectations and RTO for cross-region routing
- Maintenance window policy and advance notice (we need a max of 48h notice)
- Evidence: telemetry slices, audit logs, and sample runbooks for incidents

I attached a brief summary (OrthoSight_SLA_Reqs.pdf) for legal/procurement. Can Redwood propose an appendix and order-form language we can attach to the SOW? Also would like a DocuSign-ready version if possible — targeting signature before May 1 so pilot onboarding can proceed.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Procurement, OrthoSight Health

Attachment: OrthoSight_SLA_Reqs.pdf (1 page)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: m.singh@orthosight.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot SLA ask - uptime & P95 latency guarantees

Maya — thanks, received. Looping in Karthik (serving/runtime) and Vanessa (legal/procurement ops) to draft a concrete appendix. Two quick asks to help us shape proposals:

1) Can you share expected QPS and typical request size (avg tokens in, avg tokens out) during the pilot ramp and at steady state?
2) Is the 150ms P95 requirement specifically for cold-start-free steady-state only, or does it need to include cold-start/warmup scenarios?

I'll attach a quick telemetry template we use to size the technical profile. If you can fill that, we can give a realistic availability/latency commitment and propose fallback language (Dedicated fallback or documented degraded-mode behavior).

Proposed next step: Karthik to draft appendix language and a sample order-form clause; Vanessa will review legal/notice language. I'll aim to get a first draft back within 48 hours.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_telemetry_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: m.singh@orthosight.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-13T08:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot SLA ask - uptime & P95 latency guarantees

Jordan / Maya / Vanessa — thanks. Based on the ask, I sketched practical constraints and draft language for the order form and an SOW appendix. Key technical notes (summary):

- 99.99% monthly availability is achievable for dedicated pools under committed capacity; for shared-hosted tiers we can offer 99.95% with documented maintenance windows and a burst-protection policy.
- P95 < 150ms for /v1/generate is plausible at small scale in-region; requirement must include request size (tokens) and payload characteristics. For our standard model family, P95 is typically 120–180ms for 0–256 output tokens on A100/Xavier-class reserved nodes.
- Cross-region failover: automatic routing has 3–5 minute RTO for ephemeral SDK requests; longer for sessions requiring KV-cache reconstruction. We can add an explicit carve-out and a fall-back plan (session replay policy) in the appendix.

Suggested order-form clause (first-draft excerpt):
"Service Availability and Performance Exhibit — Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide the Service in accordance with the availability and latency targets specified on the Order Form. Availability measurements will be taken against regional production endpoints over a monthly rolling window excluding scheduled maintenance and force majeure events. For Dedicated Capacity orders, Redwood guarantees an availability target of 99.99% and will provide credits per the Service Credit Schedule below. For Hosted (multi-tenant) deployments, Redwood guarantees 99.95% availability."

I've attached a working doc with more detailed wording and an initial Service Credit Schedule. Please review and flag legal items. I intentionally left the exact numeric credits and measurement formulas for Vanessa/legal to adjust.

Attachment: sla_appendix_draft_v1.docx

—Karthik
Director, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: m.singh@orthosight.com
Date: 2026-04-14T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot SLA ask - uptime & P95 latency guarantees

Thanks Karthik — good start. A few legal/ops changes before we share a DocuSign-ready appendix:

- Narrow "scheduled maintenance" definition and require minimum 48 hours advance notice for non-emergency maintenance; allow emergency maintenance with post-facto notice.
- Replace open-ended "force majeure" phrasing with Redwood's standard force majeure clause and include examples impacting network backbone and cloud provider outages.
- Evidence path: require Redwood to provide (a) aggregated monthly telemetry used to calculate availability, (b) a 30-day sample of raw request traces for audit upon reasonable request (redacted for PII), and (c) a reference incident runbook for cross-region failover.
- Add a fallback option in the Order Form enabling OrthoSight to purchase Dedicated capacity during the pilot ramp at a pre-agreed uplift (we can include a one-time uplift schedule in the order form).

I'll add suggested edits directly in the draft and return a redline. Also attaching an evidence matrix to map telemetry fields to evidentiary artifacts.

Attachment: evidence_matrix.csv

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Maya R. Singh <m.singh@orthosight.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orthosight.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-15T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot SLA ask - uptime & P95 latency guarantees

Jordan / team — appreciate the quick turnaround and the draft appendix. A few clarifications from our side after internal review:

- The P95 latency guarantee must cover our steady-state traffic pattern (we can provide the telemetry template filled this afternoon). Cold-start variance can be treated as an exception, but it must be documented and quantified in the appendix.
- For the Dedicated fallback uplift, can Redwood provide the estimated cost delta for a 3-month pilot (expected peak QPS 150, steady-state 60 QPS)? We prefer the fallback price to be pre-agreed to speed procurement.
- DocuSign: we need a short signing window — can Redwood produce a DocuSign packet with the appendix + order form clause for signature by April 26?

If you can incorporate the documented cold-start carve-outs and provide the Dedicated uplift delta, we can sign the packet.

Thanks,
Maya

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: m.singh@orthosight.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-16T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot SLA ask - uptime & P95 latency guarantees

Maya — thanks, attaching the revised appendix and a DocuSign packet for the SOW attachment. Changes included:

- Explicit cold-start carve-out section that documents expected P95 variance during first 72 hours of a new model/region and how we measure that window.
- Service Credit Schedule for both Dedicated (99.99%) and Hosted (99.95%) options.
- Dedicated uplift estimate for the 3-month pilot at the QPS levels you supplied: uplift delta – $42,500 for committed Dedicated pool (one-time setup + monthly prorated commitment). Exact invoice and billing terms included in the order-form annex.
- Evidence matrix link and instructions for a secure S3 access path for telemetry samples during an audit.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/overview?d=RDW-7092-sla (packet: Redwood_SLA_Appendix_Orthosight_20260416.pdf)

Next steps: please review the PDF & DocuSign contents and let us know by April 26 so we can lock the onboarding calendar for the pilot. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if you want line-by-line.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_SLA_Appendix_Orthosight_20260416.pdf (DocuSign packet)
